# Palantir Bull Case

My working thesis on Palantir as of Q1 2025.

## Core Claim

Palantir's AI Platform (AIP) is converting government customers into commercial ones,
expanding the total addressable market beyond what the market currently prices in.
The bootcamp sales model is shortening enterprise sales cycles from 12 months to 6 weeks.

## Evidence

- US commercial revenue grew 55% YoY in Q4 2024
- AIP bootcamp conversion rate reportedly above 40%
- Rule of 40 score crossed 60 for the first time in Q3 2024
- Net dollar retention above 120% for three consecutive quarters

## Open Questions

What happens to AIP differentiation when hyperscalers ship competing products?
Is the government business durable post-DOGE budget cuts?
